list.title: Dashboards
list.description: Status overviews built from data that your processes publish (once, on demand or on a schedule). Dashboards only read stored data – they never call the platforms themselves.
list.emptyText: Start from a template (e.g. platform operations), then run the inventory processes that feed it – or schedule them so the data stays fresh.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.hint: Published by “{{node}}” nodes. Each run replaces the rows and adds metric values to the history used by trend charts. You see the datasets of processes you may view.
datasets.none: No datasets yet – run a process that contains a “{{node}}” node.
datasets.deleteConfirm: Delete dataset "{{key}}" and its metric history? It is recreated by the next run of {{process}}.

view.noSources: This dashboard has no data sources yet.
view.widgetsHint: Widgets show datasets published by processes with a “{{node}}” node – see datasets.

kpi.label: Stat tile
kpi.info: Stat tile: latest value of a metric (or the row count) with change and sparkline

trend.label: Trend chart
trend.info: Line chart of up to three metrics over time

status.label: Status distribution
status.info: Distribution of row statuses (good / warning / serious / critical)

table.label: Table
table.info: Rows of a dataset with status badges, search and a problems-only filter

checks.label: Checks
checks.info: Check results of the latest run of a process

freshness.label: Data freshness
freshness.info: Age of every dataset on this dashboard and the next scheduled refresh

editor.refreshSecondsHint: The dashboard only reads stored datasets; the platforms are queried by the processes (schedules) that publish them.
